meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 支持从 Emacs 内对话：你打开聊天窗口提问，或把 Org 文档的段落发给它，它的回复会作为子标题写回文档。
howto.when: 当 NanoClaw 已启用 Emacs 通道（EMACS_ENABLED=true）且你按下聊天快捷键打开缓冲区并发送消息，或使用 org-send 发送当前子树/区域时，Claude 会在 Emacs 内回复。

say.text: 帮我看看这个函数的报错怎么解决？
say.note: 在聊天缓冲区发出，Claude 会直接回复。

say.text: 对选中的代码做一次审查，指出问题。
say.note: 发送 Org 内容后，回复作为子标题出现。

say.text: 把这份会议纪要转成行动清单。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can be reached from Emacs: you open a chat buffer or send an Org section, and its reply is inserted as a child heading.
howto.when_en: Once the Emacs channel is enabled (EMACS_ENABLED=true) and you send a message from the chat buffer or use org-send on a subtree/region, Claude replies inside Emacs.

say_en.text: Why does this function throw an error?
say_en.note: Sent from the chat buffer; Claude replies directly.

say_en.text: Review the selected code and point out issues.
say_en.note: After sending org content, the reply appears as a child heading.

say_en.text: Turn these meeting notes into an action list.
